# Dexcom Data

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

Diabetes data from Dexcom G7 15-day continuous glucose monitor (CGM) sensor.

## Scope note

- Includes data from Clarity website via the Dexcom API for glucose readings collected by sensor every 5 minutes.

## Broader

- [Health Data](../HealthData/)
